skills.name: career-ops
skills.purpose: Job-search command center: paste a job description or URL and it scores the role A-F against your CV, writes an evaluation report, generates an ATS-friendly tailored CV (PDF or LaTeX), cover letter and outreach drafts, tracks applications, scans company career portals, and preps interviews (STAR story bank, practice, debrief) and offer negotiation.
skills.how_to_use: Clone the repo (or `npx @santifer/career-ops init`), add cv.md and config/profile.yml, then run `/career-ops {JD or URL}` or a mode such as `scan`, `pdf`, `cover`, `interview-prep`, `offer-prep`, `tracker`. Needs Node and Playwright Chromium for PDFs and portal checks; the router only works inside the repo (it loads modes/*.md and scripts).
skills.evidence: 73.4k stars, created 4 Apr 2026 (formerly santifer/career-ops; went viral after its author used it to land a Head of Applied AI role); #1 repo by stars in GitHub's job-search topic; skills.sh ~750 installs plus many re-hosts; claudemarketplaces 581 installs; in VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills.
skills.notes: Human-in-the-loop by design: drafts and fills forms but never submits or sends (README, modes/apply.md, modes/email.md). README states no telemetry. Portal scanner uses public Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever APIs plus Playwright/WebSearch; the user carries job-site ToS responsibility. Optional community plugins (Apify, Gmail, Notion) send data to those services; leave them off. package.json postinstall runs `npx playwright install chromium`. Whole-app skill: distil the modes, not the router.

skills.name: job-application-assistant
skills.purpose: One application end to end: fetch and score a posting against your profile, tailor a LaTeX CV, write a cover letter in your own voice (strict anti-cliché style rules), prepare the interview and archive what was submitted.
skills.how_to_use: Clone the repo, run `/setup` to build your profile from a CV or LinkedIn export, then `/apply <url>`; `/rank`, `/outcome` and `/upskill` extend it. Needs a LaTeX toolchain for CV PDFs.
skills.evidence: 44.9k stars, created 18 Mar 2026 by a geophysicist who ran his own search with it; skills.sh ~240 installs; skillsmp lists all its skills.
skills.notes: 09-web-research.md tells the agent to retry 403 pages with curl and a spoofed Chrome User-Agent (after a robots.txt check); drop that when distilling. The repo's separate linkedin-search portal skill scrapes LinkedIn's guest job endpoints and its own SKILL.md says that breaks LinkedIn ToS; the other portal CLIs are Danish job boards. Use only the application-assistant part.

skills.name: resume-builder
skills.purpose: Builds a resume conversationally without inventing facts and outputs JSON valid against the Reactive Resume schema; with the Reactive Resume MCP it also tracks applications, interviews and follow-ups and tailors a resume to a linked job description.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when someone wants a resume created or restructured; import the JSON at rxresu.me or a self-hosted instance. Application tracking needs the Reactive Resume MCP connected with your account's API key.
skills.evidence: Official Reactive Resume (open-source resume builder, 43.7k stars); skills.sh ~480 installs; claudemarketplaces 243 installs.
skills.notes: Data goes only to rxresu.me or your own instance (the vendor's own host).

skills.name: brag-sheet
skills.purpose: Turns 'what did I do?' into evidence-backed impact statements (action, result, evidence) for self-reviews, promotion packets and weekly updates; backfills forgotten work from git commits, GitHub PRs and Copilot CLI session logs and refuses to invent metrics.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'brag', 'self-review', 'promo packet', 'what did I ship'. Modes: Capture, Backfill, Review Pack. Optional git and gh CLI; the session-log mining only applies to GitHub Copilot CLI users.
skills.evidence: github/awesome-copilot (39.7k stars), added Apr 2026 from microsoft/copilot-brag-sheet; listed on skillsmp. Few installs tracked on skills.sh yet.
skills.notes: Copilot-flavoured (optional save_to_brag_sheet tool from Microsoft's extension), but the impact-writing rules are tool-agnostic.

skills.name: performance-review
skills.purpose: Performance-review kit: self-assessment template, manager review for a direct report, calibration prep (rating distribution and promotion cases), and turning vague feedback into specific behavioural examples.
skills.how_to_use: `/performance-review self-assessment | manager [name] | calibration`, or triggers when review season comes up. Part of Anthropic's human-resources plugin; HRIS connectors are optional.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh ~3.1k installs; claudemarketplaces 2.6k installs.
skills.notes: No folder LICENSE; repo Apache-2.0 applies.

skills.name: review-resume

skills.how_to_use: Give it the resume text and optionally a job posting; triggers on resume review requests. No prerequisites.
skills.evidence: phuryn/pm-skills (26.7k stars); skills.sh ~2.8k installs; claudemarketplaces 2.2k installs; in VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills.
skills.notes: PM-focused, but most of the 10 practices transfer to other roles.

skills.name: interview-system-designer

skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'design an interview process', 'build a question bank', 'calibrate our loop'. Scripts are standard-library Python 3 (`python3 scripts/interview_planner.py --role ... --level ...`).
skills.evidence: alirezarezvani/claude-skills (27.5k stars); skills.sh ~700 installs; claudemarketplaces 670 installs; mirrored on smithery.
skills.notes: Scripts checked: standard library only, no network calls. SKILL.md is short; the substance is in references/ and the scripts.

skills.name: job-post-builder
skills.purpose: Hiring side: builds a hiring packet from a brief: job post, structured interview guide with a scoring rubric, and an offer-letter template. Its sibling hiring-screener ranks applicants against the stated rubric only.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'we're hiring for', 'write a job post', 'interview questions', 'scoring rubric'. Part of Anthropic's small-business plugin; the DocuSign step (via browser) is optional.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh ~1.6k installs; claudemarketplaces 1.2k installs.
skills.notes: Aimed at small-business owners; US-centric defaults in its references.

skills.name: rendercv
skills.purpose: Teaches the agent RenderCV: write the CV as YAML and render a typographically clean PDF (plus PNG, HTML, Markdown) via Typst, with 6 themes, 22 locales and full design control.
skills.how_to_use: Install RenderCV (`uv tool install "rendercv[full]"`), then ask for a CV; the agent writes the YAML and runs `rendercv render`. Install the skill with `npx skills add rendercv/rendercv-skill`.
skills.license: none (skill repo); generator template MIT in rendercv/rendercv
skills.evidence: Official RenderCV (rendercv/rendercv, 17.7k stars, MIT); generated from scripts/rendercv_skill in the main repo and tested with promptfoo evals; claudemarketplaces ~1.7k installs.
skills.notes: The published skill repo has no LICENSE file, so link-only as published. Its source template (rendercv/rendercv scripts/rendercv_skill/skill_template.j2.md) is MIT and could be used instead.

skills.name: interview-coach
skills.purpose: Adaptive interview coach: JD decoding, a STAR storybank, one-question-at-a-time practice and full mocks (behavioural, system design, case, panel), transcript analysis scored on five dimensions with root-cause drills, post-interview debriefs, thank-you notes and negotiation scripts. Keeps state across sessions in coaching_state.md.
skills.how_to_use: Copy into a skills folder, say `kickoff` and share your resume; 23 commands (prep, practice, mock, analyze, stories, negotiate, thankyou...). Paste Zoom/Otter/Meet transcripts for analysis.
skills.evidence: 2.3k stars; skills.sh ~180 installs; appears among the top web results for Claude interview-prep skills (2026). Deepest interview-prep skill found.
skills.notes: Ships a .claude/settings.json that pre-allows Read, Edit, Write, WebFetch and WebSearch; don't copy that file.

skills.name: resume-tailor
skills.purpose: Tailors an existing resume to one posting: reorders sections, rewrites the summary and bullets to mirror the job's priorities and keywords, and keeps every claim true.
skills.how_to_use: Use after the pack's job-description-analyzer; triggers on 'tailor my resume', 'match this job description'. No prerequisites.
skills.evidence: ResumeSkills (2.5k stars, 22 resume and career skills); skills.sh ~9.5k installs; claudemarketplaces 4.8k; in VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills; the pack is re-hosted as aitmpl.com's 'career' category.
skills.notes: Install counts are near-identical across the pack (bulk installs), so weigh them lightly.

skills.name: resume-ats-optimizer

skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'ATS', 'resume not getting past screening', 'optimize for applicant tracking'. No prerequisites.
skills.evidence: skills.sh ~12.2k installs (most-installed career skill there); claudemarketplaces 6.1k; aitmpl career category.

skills.name: career-changer-translator

skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'career change', 'switching industries', 'transferable skills'. No prerequisites.
skills.evidence: skills.sh ~8.3k installs; claudemarketplaces 4.3k; aitmpl career category.

skills.name: building-a-promotion-case

skills.how_to_use: Triggers on promotion questions; frameworks and templates listed in references/artifacts.md. No prerequisites.

skills.name: job-application-agent
skills.purpose: Finds, scores, fills and submits job applications through browser automation, with a local ledger and a keychain-stored profile.
skills.how_to_use: Not recommended as a source; listed so the risk is visible.
skills.evidence: 155 stars, created Aug 2026; skills.sh ~27 installs; in VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills.
